question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current inline autogrow plus configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The requested workflow could improve long-prompt ergonomics, but it adds a second composer mode with draft, attachment, focus, and send semantics that are product/UX choices rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Treat the current autogrow textarea plus modifier-send setting as the intended long-prompt solution and close or narrow this request.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if the Control UI composer should stay lean and modal composition should not live in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the prior issue review and recently landed the adjacent Control UI composer shortcut preference, making them the best observed owner for this product-scope call.
